main_text.head: Ad Lectorem.
main_text.p: nostro rogatu facilem demittere sibi placuit) remisit, (ne quid dicam invidiosius,) sine probro; quinetiam, publici Juris facerem Hortator extitit.

Superest hæc duo porro moneam, me 1° scilicet in Textibus S. Scripturæ appellandis neque credulam neque perfunctoriam ( pro modici ratione ocii ) adhibuisse operam, & 2° Ecclesiæ nostræ hic illic accomodata suffragia ( ne ista quoque Juventutem ingenuam lateant ) siqua in Libell: Corpore haud occurrunt, cum Elencho Capitum ad sinem rejecisse.
Sed Tituli ( quod in quosdam jocatus est olim Plinius) oblitus videbor. Vale, Lector benevole, & quod dextra manu porrigitur, sinistra ne accipias precor.

page.notes: Lower half of the page is blank apart from decorative rules and specks, not printed text. Several words are damaged or faint: "scilicet" may read "scilicet" with a damaged initial; "Libell:" and "sinistra" are uncertain; "Juris" is printed as shown. The "1°" and "2°" are printed as superscript ordinals.
